text: dsh-ui-ux-pro-max 是供 DSH Web 与 Desktop profile 使用的 UI/UX 设计插件，通过 Cordis 注册 design_recommend、design_review、design_search 三个工具，并可选注册内置技能。它能从产品描述生成包含风格、配色、字体、页面模式和 UX 要点的设计建议；按平台整理 UX 评审规则；或按领域、技术栈检索设计资料。中文查询可用，设计知识随包内置并在本地检索，适合规划新界面、检查现有页面或查规范。不需要额外密钥或账号；可调整默认结果数、评审条数及技能注册开关。

dsh-ui-ux-pro-max provides three DSH tools: design_recommend generates design systems, design_review gathers UX rules, and design_search finds references by topic or stack. Chinese queries work with bundled local data. No API key is needed; skill registration and result limits are configurable.

Review my mobile screen and list the most important UX issues.

dsh-ui-ux-pro-max 的功能「设计系统建议」：根据产品类型和关键词整理推荐风格、配色令牌、字体搭配、落地页模式、UX 要点及反模式；可选输入技术栈和设计旋钮。
dsh-ui-ux-pro-max 的功能「UX 规范审查」：输入页面或组件描述并选择平台，工具检索 UX、Web、React 规范，按严重度排序并附通用交付检查清单。
dsh-ui-ux-pro-max 的功能「设计资料检索」：输入关键词并可指定领域或技术栈，返回按相关度排序的本地设计资料，支持控制结果数及是否包含废弃条目。
dsh-ui-ux-pro-max 的功能「中文检索」：中文查询会经术语扩展及 CJK 二元分词，再使用 BM25 为内置设计资料排序。
dsh-ui-ux-pro-max 的功能「设计技能注册」：默认向 DSH skills 服务注册内置 ui-ux-pro-max 技能；关闭配置后仍会注册三个设计工具。

text:
dsh-ui-ux-pro-max README · 特性：- **三个工具**：生成设计系统、审查 UX、按领域或技术栈检索。
- **数据完全内置**：4319 行设计数据库随包发布，零网络、零 Python、零第三方运行时依赖。
- **中文优先**：全中文输出，400+ 中文术语映射 + CJK 二元分词；单字查询按领域兜底。
- **设计旋钮**：`variance` 大胆度 / `motion` 动效强度（附 GSAP 方案）/ `density` 密度，均为 1-10。
- **纯 JavaScript**：BM25 检索引擎 + 设计系统生成器，Node `^22.19 || >=24`。
dsh-ui-ux-pro-max README · 安装：三种方式任选其一。当前版本 **1.4.1**；以 [npm 包页](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-ui-ux-pro-max) 实际发布的版本为准。

dsh-ui-ux-pro-max README · 从插件市场 / npm：```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add --save-exact dsh-ui-ux-pro-max@1.4.1
dsh plugin --profile web     add --save-exact dsh-ui-ux-pro-max@1.4.1
```

> DSH Desktop 不把 `dsh` 加入 PATH，安装后请新开一个终端；若仍提示找不到命令，先执行 `npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh`。

dsh-ui-ux-pro-max README · 从源码安装（Windows）：```powershell
git clone https://github.com/ChenYiming-aaa/dsh-ui-ux-pro-max.git
cd dsh-ui-ux-pro-max
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1
```

脚本会按 `package.json` 的 `files[]` 白名单复制文件到 profile 的共享 `node_modules`，并幂等追加注册条目；支持 `-ProfileDir` / `-ProfileName`，`-WhatIf` 可先预览。

dsh-ui-ux-pro-max README · 手动安装（任意平台）：把包放入 `<profile>\..\node_modules\dsh-ui-ux-pro-max\`，然后在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 追加：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: ui-ux-pro-max
      name: dsh-ui-ux-pro-max
      config: {}

重启 DSH Desktop，或运行 `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`。

安装完成后可以问一句「推荐一个金融数据看板的设计风格」来验证工具是否生效。

dsh-ui-ux-pro-max README · 三个工具：| 工具 | 用途 | 主要参数 |
|---|---|---|
| `design_recommend` | 产品类型 + 关键词 → 完整设计系统：风格优先级、HEX 配色与 CSS 变量、字体搭配、落地页模式、UX 要点、反模式、旋钮 | `query`（必填）、`projectName`、`stack`、`variance`、`motion`、`density` |
| `design_review` | 按 UX + 移动端 + React 性能规范审查 UI，按严重度排序，附交付前检查清单 | `target`（必填）、`platform`、`maxRules` |
| `design_search` | 按领域或技术栈检索设计知识；可选 `includeDeprecated` 包含废弃条目 | `query`（必填）、`domain`、`stack`、`maxResults`、`includeDeprecated` |

dsh-ui-ux-pro-max README · 三个工具：`design_search` 的 `domain` 可选值：`style` / `color` / `chart` / `landing` / `product` / `ux` / `typography` / `icons` / `gsap` / `react` / `web` / `google-fonts`；`stack` 为 22 个技术栈之一（如 `react`、`nextjs`、`vue`、`flutter`、`swiftui`、`javafx`），与 `domain` 二选一。

`design_review` 的 `platform` 可选 `web`（默认）/ `mobile` / `desktop` / `react-native` / `flutter`。它只影响**同严重度内**的排序：匹配平台的规则优先，不匹配的降权保留而非过滤；`react-native` 与 `flutter` 会额外附加该技术栈的规范。

text:
dsh-ui-ux-pro-max README · 设计旋钮：三个旋钮都是 1-10 的整数，不传则使用风格自带的默认值：

| 旋钮 | 1 | 10 | 附带效果 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `variance` | 居中、极简、对称 | 大胆、不对称、强对比 | 影响风格与布局建议 |
| `motion` | 克制 | 复杂编排 | 高值附 GSAP 动效片段 |
| `density` | 宽松 | 紧凑、看板化 | 覆盖间距刻度（spacing scale） |

dsh-ui-ux-pro-max README · 内置数据：| 类别 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| 设计素材 | 风格 **88** · 调色板 **192** · 字体搭配 **74** · 图表 **25** · 落地页模式 **34** |
| 组件与动效 | 图标 **105** · GSAP 动效 **17** |
| 审查规范 | UX 规范 **119** · React 性能 **44** · 移动端接口 **32** · 推理规则 **192** |
| 检索支撑 | 产品类型 **192** · 技术栈 **22** · Google 字体 **1934**（懒加载） |

88 种风格中有 9 条标记为 `deprecated`，默认不参与检索（实际可检索 79 条）。风格与技术栈的废弃条目采用同一策略：默认排除，查询中显式包含 `legacy` / `deprecated` 时保留，便于复刻旧项目。

数据移植自 `nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill@56ea9cf`（2026-10-15）。

dsh-ui-ux-pro-max README · 站点的构建与部署：两个站是同级目录 `gallery/` 与 `handbook/`，站点根 `index.html` 跳转到 `/gallery/`。同级布局让本地双击 html 打开与线上部署的相对路径完全一致，`../handbook/` 这类互链在两种场景下都成立。手册**单独构建、单独成站**，只依赖 `tools/atlas/`、`data/`、`assets/atlas-fonts/`。

```bash
npm run fonts             # 首次或换字体时：下载 91 个字族的 latin 子集
npm run build             # 两站一起构建（= build:gallery + build:handbook）
npm run build:gallery     # 只构建图鉴 → gallery/
npm run build:handbook    # 只构建手册 → handbook/

dsh-ui-ux-pro-max README · 站点的构建与部署：推送到 `main` 后 `.github/workflows/pages.yml` 会重建两站、跑两份结构检查，再合并成一个 Pages 产物发布（仓库 Pages 的 Source 为「GitHub Actions」）。中文名称、导读与预览主题在 `tools/showcase/theme-data.mjs`，手册的数据派生在 `tools/atlas/data.mjs`。

dsh-ui-ux-pro-max README · 配置：插件只有三个配置项，写在注册条目的 `config` 里，全部可省略：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: ui-ux-pro-max
      name: dsh-ui-ux-pro-max
      config:

| 配置项 | 类型 | 默认值 | 取值范围 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `maxResults` | 整数 | `3` | 1-8 | `design_search` 的默认返回条数；调用时传参可覆盖 |
| `reviewRules` | 整数 | `8` | 1-20 | `design_review` 的默认规范条数；调用时传参可覆盖 |
| `skill` | 布尔 | `true` | `true` / `false` | 设为 `false` 时只注册三个工具，不注册技能 |

未知字段会被忽略；类型或范围不合法时插件在加载期报错，不会带病启动。

dsh-ui-ux-pro-max README · 常见问题：**安装后工具或技能没有出现？**
依次检查：`dsh` 命令是否指向正确的 profile；profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 是否有 `id: ui-ux-pro-max` 的 `insert` 条目；Node 版本是否满足 `^22.19 || >=24`；修改后是否重启了 DSH。

**npm 上的版本比仓库旧？**
直接指定已发布版本安装，或改用源码安装：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-ui-ux-pro-max@1.4.1
```

**需要联网吗？**
不需要。数据全部随包内置，Google 字体列表也是本地文件，插件运行时不发起任何请求；两个站点同样零外部请求。

**为什么搜不到某些风格？**
它们可能被标记为 `deprecated` 并默认排除。在查询里带上 `legacy` 或 `deprecated` 即可召回。

dsh-ui-ux-pro-max README · 常见问题：**中文单字查询（`图` / `色` / `字` / `动`）结果不理想？**
单字信息量不足，插件会先把已登记的单字映射到对应领域；若扩展后仍无命中，则返回该领域的默认条目并标记 `fallback`。换成具体词组效果更好，例如「金融 配色」「图表 对比」。

**支持哪些 DSH 版本？**
覆盖 0.1.0 / 0.1.1 / 0.2.0 / 0.2.1 四条预发布线及其正式版（上界 `<0.3.0-0`）。已在 0.1.1-rc.1、0.2.0-rc.2、0.2.1-rc.2 验证工具定义、执行、输出 schema、渲染与技能注册。详见 [DSH-COMPAT.md](https://github.com/ChenYiming-aaa/dsh-ui-ux-pro-max/blob/main/docs/DSH-COMPAT.md)。

**可以替换或扩充数据吗？**
数据在 `data/index.json` 与 `data/fonts.json`，随包发布；目前不支持运行时加载外部数据文件，需要修改后重新打包。

dsh-ui-ux-pro-max README · 常见问题：**只装插件、不装技能可以吗？**
可以，把配置里的 `skill` 设为 `false`，三个模型工具仍然可用。

dsh-ui-ux-pro-max README · Features：- **Three tools**: generate a design system, review UX, search by domain or stack.
- **Fully bundled data**: 4,319 rows shipped with the package; zero network, zero Python,
  zero third-party runtime dependencies.
- **Chinese-first**: Chinese output, 400+ term dictionary and CJK bigram tokenization;
  single-character queries (`图` / `色` / `字` / `动`) fall back to the detected domain.
- **Design dials**: `variance` / `motion` (with GSAP snippet) / `density`, each 1-10.
- **Pure JavaScript**: BM25 search + design-system generator; Node `^22.19 || >=24`.

dsh-ui-ux-pro-max README · Install：Pick one of the three options. Current version **1.4.1**; use whatever is actually published
on [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-ui-ux-pro-max).

dsh-ui-ux-pro-max README · Plugin market / npm：```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add --save-exact dsh-ui-ux-pro-max@1.4.1
dsh plugin --profile web     add --save-exact dsh-ui-ux-pro-max@1.4.1
```

> DSH Desktop does not put `dsh` on PATH — open a new terminal afterwards. If the command is
> still missing, run `npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh`.

dsh-ui-ux-pro-max README · From source (Windows)：```powershell
git clone https://github.com/ChenYiming-aaa/dsh-ui-ux-pro-max.git
cd dsh-ui-ux-pro-max
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1
```

The installer copies only the `files[]` whitelist into the profile's shared `node_modules`
and idempotently appends the registration entry. `-ProfileDir` / `-ProfileName` are supported,
and `-WhatIf` previews the changes.

dsh-ui-ux-pro-max README · Manual (any platform)：Copy the package into `<profile>\..\node_modules\dsh-ui-ux-pro-max\`, then append to the
profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: ui-ux-pro-max
      name: dsh-ui-ux-pro-max
      config: {}

Restart DSH Desktop, or run `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`.

To verify, ask "recommend a design system for a fintech dashboard".

dsh-ui-ux-pro-max README · The three tools：| Tool | Purpose | Main parameters |
|---|---|---|
| `design_recommend` | Product type + keywords → complete design system: ranked styles, HEX palette and CSS variables, font pairing, landing pattern, UX guidelines, anti-patterns, dials | `query` (required), `projectName`, `stack`, `variance`, `motion`, `density` |
| `design_review` | Review UI against UX + mobile + React performance guidelines, severity-ranked, with a pre-delivery checklist | `target` (required), `platform`, `maxRules` |
| `design_search` | Search design knowledge by domain or stack; optional `includeDeprecated` includes deprecated rows | `query` (required), `domain`, `stack`, `maxResults`, `includeDeprecated` |

dsh-ui-ux-pro-max README · The three tools：`domain` values for `design_search`: `style` / `color` / `chart` / `landing` / `product` /
`ux` / `typography` / `icons` / `gsap` / `react` / `web` / `google-fonts`. `stack` accepts one
of the 22 stacks (`react`, `nextjs`, `vue`, `flutter`, `swiftui`, `javafx`, …) and is mutually
exclusive with `domain`.

dsh-ui-ux-pro-max README · The three tools：`platform` for `design_review`: `web` (default) / `mobile` / `desktop` / `react-native` /
`flutter`. It only orders rules within the same severity: matching rules first, mismatches
down-weighted but kept. `react-native` and `flutter` also add that stack's guidelines.

dsh-ui-ux-pro-max README · Examples：Pick the tool by what you are actually doing, and pass the details you already have:

```text
dsh-ui-ux-pro-max README · New project: get a full design system first：design_recommend("财务 数据看板 深色 高密度", projectName: "财务中台", stack: "react")

dsh-ui-ux-pro-max README · Design dials：All dials are integers from 1 to 10 and default to the value implied by the chosen style:

| Dial | 1 | 10 | Side effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| `variance` | centered, minimal, symmetric | bold, asymmetric, high contrast | shifts style and layout advice |
| `motion` | restrained | complex choreography | high values add a GSAP snippet |
| `density` | airy | compact, dashboard-like | overrides the spacing scale |

|---|---|
| Design assets | Styles **88** · Palettes **192** · Font pairings **74** · Charts **25** · Landing patterns **34** |
| Components / motion | Icons **105** · GSAP presets **17** |
| Review rules | UX guidelines **119** · React performance **44** · Mobile interface **32** · Reasoning profiles **192** |
| Retrieval support | Product types **192** · Stacks **22** · Google Fonts **1934** (lazy-loaded) |

dsh-ui-ux-pro-max README · Bundled data：9 of the 88 styles are `deprecated` and excluded from search by default (79 searchable).
Deprecated rows (styles and stack guidelines) follow one rule: excluded by default, kept when
the query explicitly mentions `legacy` / `deprecated`.

Data is ported from `nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill@56ea9cf` (2026-10-15).

dsh-ui-ux-pro-max README · Building & deploying the sites：`gallery/` and `handbook/` sit side by side; the site root `index.html` redirects to `/gallery/`.
The sibling layout makes relative links such as `../handbook/` resolve identically when opening
files directly and when deployed. The handbook **builds on its own** — it needs only
`tools/atlas/`, `data/` and `assets/atlas-fonts/`, not `gallery/`.

dsh-ui-ux-pro-max README · Building & deploying the sites：```bash
npm run fonts             # one-off: fetch the latin subsets for 91 families
npm run build             # build both sites (= build:gallery + build:handbook)
npm run build:gallery     # gallery only → gallery/
npm run build:handbook    # handbook only → handbook/

dsh-ui-ux-pro-max README · Building & deploying the sites：Pushes to `main` rebuild both sites, run the structure checks, and publish one merged Pages
artifact through `.github/workflows/pages.yml` (Pages source is “GitHub Actions”). Chinese copy and
preview themes live in `tools/showcase/theme-data.mjs`; handbook data derivation lives in
`tools/atlas/data.mjs`.

dsh-ui-ux-pro-max README · Configuration：The plugin exposes three optional settings under the registration entry's `config`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: ui-ux-pro-max
      name: dsh-ui-ux-pro-max
      config:

dsh-ui-ux-pro-max README · Configuration：| Key | Type | Default | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `maxResults` | integer | `3` | 1-8 | Default `design_search` result count; a per-call value overrides it |
| `reviewRules` | integer | `8` | 1-20 | Default `design_review` rule count; a per-call value overrides it |
| `skill` | boolean | `true` | `true` / `false` | `false` registers the three tools without the skill |

Unknown keys are ignored; invalid types or ranges raise at load time instead of starting in a
broken state.

dsh-ui-ux-pro-max README · FAQ：**The tools or skill don't show up after installing.**
Check, in order: `dsh` points at the right profile; the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` has an
`insert` entry with `id: ui-ux-pro-max`; Node satisfies `^22.19 || >=24`; DSH was restarted.

**npm has an older version than the repository.**
Install a published version explicitly, or use the source install:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-ui-ux-pro-max@1.4.1
```

dsh-ui-ux-pro-max README · FAQ：**Does it need network access?**
No. All data ships with the package, the Google Fonts list is a local file, and the plugin
makes no requests at runtime; both sites are equally self-contained.

**Why are some styles missing from search results?**
They may be marked `deprecated` and excluded by default. Mention `legacy` or `deprecated` in
the query to include them.

dsh-ui-ux-pro-max README · FAQ：**Single-character queries (`图` / `色` / `字` / `动`) give weak results.**
One character carries little signal. Registered characters are first mapped to their domain;
if the expansion still matches nothing, the plugin returns that domain's default rows and marks
them with `fallback`. A concrete phrase works better, e.g. "金融 配色" or "图表 对比".

dsh-ui-ux-pro-max README · FAQ：**Which DSH versions are supported?**
The 0.1.0 / 0.1.1 / 0.2.0 / 0.2.1 pre-release lines and their stable releases (upper bound
`<0.3.0-0`). Verified on 0.1.1-rc.1, 0.2.0-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.2 for tool definitions,
execution, output schema, rendering and skill registration. See
[DSH-COMPAT.md](https://github.com/ChenYiming-aaa/dsh-ui-ux-pro-max/blob/main/docs/DSH-COMPAT.md).

dsh-ui-ux-pro-max README · FAQ：**Can I replace or extend the data?**
The data lives in `data/index.json` and `data/fonts.json` and is shipped with the package.
Loading external data files at runtime is not supported — edit and repackage instead.

**Can I use the tools without the skill?**
Yes — set `skill` to `false`; all three model tools remain available.
